candidates.description: This vector activates strongly for the Thai consonant 'ค' (kho khwai) and its common syllabic combinations.
This vector represents Thai script characters and tone marks.
This vector represents the Thai copula verb "เป็น" (to be) and its frequent subword tokenizations alongside its English translation equivalents.
This vector activates on common Thai script characters and syllable components.
These tokens represent letters and syllable blocks starting with the Thai consonant 'อ' (Ang Ang).
This vector is associated with the concepts of existence, being, and philosophical '-ism' suffixes across multiple languages.
This vector activates on non-English words, proper names, and linguistic fragments from a diverse mix of scripts and languages.
This feature activates on names and concepts associated with prominent philosophers and existential themes.
This feature vector activates on common grammatical conjunctions and prepositions in Thai and English.
This vector activates common derivational suffixes and morphological endings used to form nouns, adjectives, and verbs across multiple languages.
